name: Basilica of the Immaculate Conception
history: The parish was founded in 1728 in Natchitoches, the oldest European settlement in the Louisiana Purchase territory; its first church stood inside the walls of Fort St. John the Baptist. The present building, the seventh, was begun in 1857, but the Civil War and Reconstruction delayed it until about 1900-1905. It was the cathedral until 1910 and became a basilica in 2009.
arch: A twin-towered church whose construction spanned almost half a century.
features: The fifth church was destroyed in the Natchitoches fire of 1838.
The sixth church became the first cathedral of the Diocese of Natchitoches in 1853.

look.d: They rose slowly, through war and Reconstruction.
Six churches stood before this one.

fun: The bishop's seat moved to Alexandria in 1910.
journal: Seven churches since 1728. This one took the Civil War and then some to finish.
